_doc: Soft-body touchdown experiments for the grey-box identification of the rigid twin's touchdown model (tools/flight/touchdown/README.md). Factors = state at the first tyre contact (conventions in tools/flight/touchdown/lib.mjs); ranges here override lib.mjs FACTORS. fit / holdout: maximin Latin hypercubes (jittered strata, simulated-annealing column swaps on the phi_p criterion) with their own seeds, restricted to genuine first contacts (feasibility: the touching tyre node approaches at >= vmin and no tyre node was below the street in the `window` before). anchors: one factor at a time around `nominal`. drop: options of drop.mjs for every case.
_drop_doc: joints 0.55 = the connector give factor every launch preset flies with (spec/launch-presets.json); the first run (20261021-020006) used the solver default 1, i.e. arms 1.8x stronger than in any flight.
